name: Stormbringer: Summon: Thunder Orb spawns the orb and its Orb Shock (#3767)
contract: Summon: Thunder Orb (801802) promises "Summon a Thunder Orb at the target location for 16 sec that triggers an Orb Shock and generates 10 Static". Spell.dbc gives Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON with EffectMiscValue[0] 50074 and EffectMiscValueB[0] 61, DurationIndex 387 = SpellDuration 16000 ms, and Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL 804084 whose Effect[1] 175 adds EffectMiscValue[1] = 10 stacks of Static (803102). The Static clause is delivered natively by SpellEffects.cpp and is asserted as the baseline half. Creature 50074 ships no creature_template, so Creature::CreateFromProto rejects the summon and no orb appears, and nothing binds Orb Shock (801863, EffectAmplitude 2000 ms -> 801868) to the summon, so no shock is ever cast. Orb Shock 801868 hits SpellRadius(8) = 5 yd around the orb, which only reaches the dummy 10 yd away if the orb is placed at the target and not at the caster's feet.

steps.label: BASELINE: no Thunder Orb (creature 50074, Spell.dbc EffectMiscValue[0]) is owned before the cast
BASELINE: Static (803102) sits below its StackAmount 100 cap minus the 10 this cast adds
NATIVE: the cast adds 10 Static, from 804084 Effect[1] EffectMiscValue[1] = 10
DISCRIMINATING: one Thunder Orb 50074 is summoned, from EffectMiscValue[0] = 50074 with SummonProperties 61
DISCRIMINATING: the orb's Orb Shock 801868 damages the dummy, from 801863 EffectAmplitude 2000 ms
DISCRIMINATING: Orb Shock leaves its SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER debuff on the dummy
The orb despawns after its 16000 ms duration
